sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.content: Autonomous AI code review represents a high-velocity wedge into the $28B DevSecOps market. By shifting vulnerability detection left to PR merge time, this venture commands 85%+ software gross margins with enterprise ACVs ranging from $18k to $65k.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: crunchbase] $4.2B invested into AI DevSecOps category in 2025

sections.title: Problem & Opportunity
sections.content: Engineering leaders lose 22% of developer velocity to manual PR reviews and retroactive security audits. Traditional static analysis tools (SonarQube, Snyk) flag high false positives; an autonomous LLM auditor with verified codebase context cuts audit time by 60%.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: newsapi] 78% of enterprise CTOs mandate shift-left automated PR security

sections.title: Technical Architecture
sections.content: Google Cloud Run microservices with Vertex AI private endpoints. Ephemeral worker nodes pull PR diffs, execute tree-sitter AST pruning to redact secrets, and query an isolated Vector Search index per tenant. Zero raw code persists in databases.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: gcp_benchmarks] Zero-trust isolated execution guarantees 99.95% SLA

sections.title: Go-to-Market Strategy
sections.content: Product-led growth (PLG) developer tier on GitHub Marketplace feeding bottom-up enterprise sales. Seed target: 50 open-source repositories and 25 paying mid-market engineering teams.

sections.content: Audited compliance governance for EU AI Act (High-Risk Classification avoidance), US FTC automated algorithmic liability, and SOC2 Type II automated logging. Disclaimers and explicit human-in-the-loop signoffs are contractually enforced.

assumptions.assumption: Developers will trust AI to suggest inline code modifications without human peer pushback.
assumptions.evidence: 68% of developers dismiss bots that generate more than 3 comments per PR.
assumptions.recommended_action: Introduce confidence score threshold: only comment when certainty exceeds 90%.

assumptions.assumption: Enterprise security teams will permit cloud LLM processing of proprietary code.
assumptions.evidence: Strict financial institutions prohibit multi-tenant API calls with code context.
assumptions.recommended_action: Build a self-hosted Docker agent proxy that executes AST pruning locally before API transmission.

failure_modes.title: Microsoft Copilot Platform Bundling
failure_modes.description: GitHub expands native Copilot Autofix into PR triage, eliminating need for standalone third-party bot.
failure_modes.mitigation: Focus on multi-git host flexibility (GitLab, Bitbucket, self-hosted) where GitHub Copilot cannot integrate.

failure_modes.title: Prompt Injection via Untrusted Pull Requests
failure_modes.description: Malicious contributors embed zero-width prompt injection payloads in commit messages to exfiltrate CI/CD secrets.
failure_modes.mitigation: Isolate the review bot to read-only permissions and sanitize all inputs through an AST security gateway.

brd_json.Executive Summary: A lean 4-week validation scope focused strictly on Python and TypeScript GitHub pull requests. Eliminate on-prem complex deployments; validate developer willingness-to-pay via a $19/dev tier before enterprise sales.
brd_json.Problem & Opportunity: Developers ignore tools that slow down PR merges. The core bottleneck is speed: developers will abandon any bot that takes longer than 90 seconds to review a pull request.
brd_json.Technical Architecture: Serverless AWS Lambda / Google Cloud Run execution layer consuming GitHub webhooks. Single-pass LLM prompt with pre-computed AST filters to keep response times under 45 seconds.
brd_json.Go-to-Market Strategy: Launch on Hacker News and Product Hunt. Target YC early-stage founders and solo developers first; achieve 100 active repositories before hiring enterprise reps.
brd_json.Regulatory & Compliance Risk: Avoid HIPAA and SOC2 scope initially by explicitly forbidding analysis of confidential private healthcare repositories; focus on open-source and standard commercial SaaS.
brd_json.Financial Plan & Unit Economics: Operate within a $15,000 bootstrapped runway. Use prompt compression and batch embeddings to cap inference costs at $0.03 per reviewed commit.

agent_outputs.raw_text: The Lean assessment dictates a rapid 4-week MVP loop targeting speed and developer love before heavy enterprise compliance.

brd_json.Executive Summary: Zero-trust enterprise architecture featuring isolated ephemeral runners, Google Cloud Secret Manager, BigQuery audit trail logging, and 99.95% availability SLA guarantees.
brd_json.Problem & Opportunity: Enterprise codebases contain proprietary IP, API keys, and PII. Sending raw source code to external multi-tenant LLM endpoints without strict AST token sanitization is a fatal security violation.
brd_json.Technical Architecture: Google Cloud Run microservices with Vertex AI private endpoints. Ephemeral worker nodes pull PR diffs, execute tree-sitter AST pruning to redact secrets, and query an isolated Vector Search index per tenant. Zero raw code persists in databases.
brd_json.Go-to-Market Strategy: Security-first procurement enablement. Publish automated SOC2 Type II compliance reports and provide self-hosted Docker agent connectors for on-premise GitLab/Bitbucket clusters.
brd_json.Regulatory & Compliance Risk: Mandatory adherence to ISO 27001, SOC2, and EU Data Act. Enforce tenant encryption keys (CMEK) via Google Cloud KMS.
brd_json.Financial Plan & Unit Economics: Infrastructure budget: $1,200/month baseline cluster cost on GCP + $0.06/PR compute & LLM token cost. Enterprise margin profile remains sustainable above 78%.

agent_outputs.raw_text: The CTO assessment establishes zero-trust infrastructure, tenant data isolation, and AST secret redaction as non-negotiable foundations.

brd_json.Executive Summary: Frictionless inline PR reviews meeting developers directly inside GitHub and GitLab interfaces. Zero external dashboards required for daily triage, maximizing adoption velocity.
brd_json.Problem & Opportunity: Developers experience alert fatigue from noisy linters. If an AI reviewer comments on trivial indentation or posts 15 nitpicks, developers disable it within 48 hours.
brd_json.Technical Architecture: Strict signal-to-noise thresholding: comments are restricted to high-confidence security vectors and logical race conditions. Inline interactive 'Apply Suggestion' GitHub diff buttons allow 1-click fixes.
brd_json.Go-to-Market Strategy: Delightful onboarding: 2-click GitHub App installation with zero config files required. Auto-generates an initial repository security score card on day 1.
brd_json.Regulatory & Compliance Risk: Transparent explainability: every automated recommendation must include a 1-sentence rationale and link to CVE vulnerability benchmarks.
brd_json.Financial Plan & Unit Economics: High user retention (>85% month-3) driven by low-friction inline workflows, ensuring customer lifetime value (LTV) exceeds $4,200 against $380 acquisition cost.

agent_outputs.raw_text: The UX assessment demands frictionless in-PR interactions, 1-click diff approvals, and ruthless suppression of noisy nitpicks.

brd_json.Executive Summary: Audited compliance governance for EU AI Act (High-Risk Classification avoidance), US FTC automated algorithmic liability, and SOC2 Type II automated logging.
brd_json.Problem & Opportunity: Enterprises handling financial or patient data risk statutory fines if third-party AI models process code without formal Data Processing Agreements (DPA) and GDPR Article 28 validation.
brd_json.Technical Architecture: Immutable tamper-proof audit trails logged to Google BigQuery `brd_runs` with SHA-256 commit hashes, user approvals, and zero training on customer IP clauses.
brd_json.Go-to-Market Strategy: Target enterprise compliance officers with pre-certified DPA agreements, ISO 27001 mappings, and HIPAA Business Associate Agreements (BAA).
brd_json.Regulatory & Compliance Risk: Critical liability: If the AI bot approves vulnerable code that leads to a production data breach, disclaimers and explicit 'human-in-the-loop' signoffs must be contractually enforced.
brd_json.Financial Plan & Unit Economics: Allocate $20,000 for external SOC2 Type II audit and legal DPA certification during seed stage.

agent_outputs.raw_text: The Regulator assessment mandates verifiable audit logs, clear human-in-the-loop liability boundaries, and GDPR-compliant DPAs.

brd_json.Executive Summary: Vulnerability assessment revealing severe platform dependency risks on Microsoft/GitHub Copilot, potential prompt injection via malicious PR comments, and churn vulnerability.
brd_json.Problem & Opportunity: GitHub can commoditize this product overnight by expanding native Copilot Autofix. Furthermore, attackers can craft pull requests with hidden prompt injection vectors to exfiltrate repository secrets via the bot.
brd_json.Technical Architecture: Mandatory adversarial sanitization layer: strip zero-width characters and parse all user PR comments through an isolated heuristic safety filter before passing to LLM context.
brd_json.Go-to-Market Strategy: Avoid competing head-to-head with generic GitHub Copilot. Win on deep multi-repo architecture dependencies and multi-cloud GitLab/Bitbucket support where GitHub Copilot cannot integrate.
brd_json.Regulatory & Compliance Risk: Catastrophic risk of prompt injection poisoning the bot's review suggestions. Implement rigid output schema validation and forbid the bot from ever possessing write/merge permissions.
brd_json.Financial Plan & Unit Economics: Model 35% annual churn due to GitHub Copilot feature bundling; build proprietary AST security rules to create high switching costs.
